title: Paired-end analysis of transcriptional start sites
protocol: Prepare total RNA from Drosophila embryos using TRIzol reagent.
Clean up the isolated RNA using RNeasy Mini kit to remove genomic DNA contamination.
Elute the cleaned RNA with 80 μl nuclease-free water after on-column DNase I digestion.
(Optional) Check the integrity of purified RNA using a 1.2% formaldehyde agarose gel or Agilent RNA Nano Labchip.
Proceed to polyA+ RNA selection if RNA samples pass quality control.
Select polyA+ RNA by incubating total RNA with Dynabeads (dT)25.
Perform two rounds of polyA+ selection with Dynabeads (dT)25 according to manufacturer’s protocol.
Elute the polyA+ RNA with 30 μl elution buffer (10mM Tris-HCl, pH7.5).
Remove residual lithium from the sample using an RNeasy MinElute kit following the manufacturer's protocol.
Elute the column twice with 40 μl nuclease-free water.
Quantify the resulting products with a nanodrop spectrophotometer.

Prepare the BAP reaction in an RNase-free 1.7ml tube by adding RNA, 80 μl BAP enzyme (Takara), 6 μl 10x BAP buffer (Takara), 10 μl RNasin ribonuclease inhibitor (Promega), and 2.5 μl nuclease-free water.
Incubate the reaction at 37 °C for 45 min.
Add 100 μl nuclease-free water to the reaction.
Extract once with 200 μl phenol/chloroform.
Extract again with 200 μl chloroform.
Perform ethanol precipitation by adding 20 μl 3 M NaOAc (pH 5.2), 2 μl GlycoBlue, and 500 μl ethanol to the reaction mixture.
Wash the pellet once with 70% ethanol.
Dissolve RNA in 85.5 μl nuclease-free water.
Prepare the following reaction in a RNase-free 1.7 ml tube:
Add BAP treated RNA from step 7 (85.5 μl).
Add 10x TAP buffer (Epicentre) (10 μl).
Add TAP enzyme (Epicentre) (2 μl).
Add RNasin ribonuclease inhibitor (Promega) (2 μl).
Incubate the reaction at 37 °C for 1 h.
Add 100 μl nuclease-free water to the reaction.
Extract once with 200 μl phenol/chloroform and then with 200 μl chloroform.
Perform ethanol precipitation by adding 20 μl 3 M NaOAc (pH 5.2).
Add 2 μl GlycoBlue.
Add 500 μl ethanol to the reaction mixture.
Wash the pellet once with 70% ethanol.
Dissolve the BAP and TAP treated RNA in 13 μl nuclease-free water.
Combine BAT/TAP treated polyA+ RNA from step 9 (13 μl) with Mme_CAP_RDhyb (IDT) (30 μM PAGE purified, 2 μl).
Add 10x T4 RNA ligase buffer (NEB) (10 μl).
Add 40% PEG8000 (0.2 μM filtered and autoclaved) (10 μl).
Add RNasin ribonuclease inhibitor (Promega) (62.5 μl).
Add T4 RNA ligase1 (NEB) (2.5 μl).
Mix the reaction well by pipetting.
Incubate at room temperature for at least 3 h (or overnight).
Add 100 μl of nuclease-free water to the reaction.
Extract once with 200 μl phenol/chloroform.
Extract a second time with 200 μl chloroform.
Purify the supernatant from Step 11 using an RNeasy MinElute kit according to the manufacturer’s protocol.
Elute linker-ligated RNA with 20 μl nuclease-free water.
Prepare the reaction in a PCR tube: Add RNA sample from previous step, 20 μl of 10mM dNTPs, each, and 2 μl of 10uM Mme_RTN6 primer.
Incubate the reaction for 5 min at 65 °C.
Chill on ice for ≥ 1 min.
Add 8 μl of 5x first strand buffer, 2 μl of 0.1M DTT, 2 μl of RNasin ribonuclease inhibitor, and 2 μl of 20x Actinomycin D to the reaction tube.
Add 2 μl of SuperScript III reverse transcriptase to complete the reaction volume up to 40 μl.
Mix the reaction thoroughly.
Incubate at 25 °C for 5 min.
Incubate at 50 °C for 1 h.
Incubate at 70 °C for 15 min, then hold at 10 °C.
Add 1 μl of RNase H (2 Units) to the reaction.
Incubate at 37 °C for 20 min.
Purify the samples using a ZYMO DNA clean & concentrator-5 kit according to the manufacturer’s protocol.
Elute with 20 μl nuclease-free water.
Prepare purified cDNA from step 15 in a PCR tube.
Add 0.25 μl 5x HF buffer (NEB) to the PCR tube.
Add 4 μl 10 μM Mme_F (IDT).
Add 1 μl 10 μM Mme_R or fly_GAPDH1_R (IDT).
Add 1 ul 10 mM dNTP, each (Bioline).
Add 0.4 μl Phusion high fidelity DNA polymerase (NEB).
Add 0.2 μl Nuclease-free water.
Incubate the PCR tube at 98 °C for 30 sec.
Perform 30 cycles of thermal cycling: 98 °C for 10 sec, 67 °C for 10 sec and 72 °C for 90 sec.
Incubate the reaction mixture at 72 °C for 10 min.
Take 3 μl RT-PCR product to run on a 1.5% agarose gel.

QC is passed if positive control (Mme_F + fly_GAPDH1_R) shows specific band, experimental control (Mme_F + Mme_R) shows strong smear and single primer amplification (Mme_F only or Mme_R only) shows no or weak smear.
Prepare cDNA from step 19 in a UV treated PCR tube.
Add 16 μl 5x HF buffer (NEB) to the PCR tube.
Add 10 μl 10 μM Mme_F (IDT).
Add 2.5 μl 10 μM Mme_R (IDT).
Add 2.5 μl 10 mM dNTP, each (Bioline).
Add 1 μl Phusion HF DNA polymerase (NEB).
Add 0.5 μl Nuclease-free water.
Incubate the PCR tube at 98 °C for 30 sec.
Perform thermal cycling: 98 °C for 10 sec, 67 °C for 10 sec and 72 °C for 90 sec.
Incubate the reaction mixture at 72 °C for 10 min.
Perform the thermal cycling at 98 °C for 30 seconds.
Cycle through 5 cycles of 98 °C for 10 seconds, 67 °C for 10 seconds, and 72 °C for 90 seconds.
Incubate at 72 °C for 10 minutes.
Add 5 μl Exonuclease I to the 50 μl PCR reaction.
Incubate at 37 °C for 45 minutes.
Heat incubate at 80 °C for 20 minutes.
Hold the reaction at 10 °C.
Purify the samples with ZYMO Clean & Concentrator-5 kit.
Elute with 10 μl nuclease-free water.
Combine purified PCR product from step 21 with 10 μl 10x Ampligase buffer in a UV treated PCR tube.
Add 3 μl OptiKinase, 1.5 μl 100 mM ATP, and 1.5 μl 100 mM DTT to the reaction mixture.
Include 0.3 μl nuclease-free water.
Reach a total reaction volume of 27.6 μl by adding appropriate volumes.
Incubate the reaction at 37 °C for 30 minutes.
Heat inactivate OptiKinase at 95 °C for 2 minutes.
Hold the reaction at 4 °C.
Add 10 μM TSS_Col3_short to the reaction mixture.
Include Ampligase (Epicentre) in the PCR hood.
Reach a total reaction volume of 30 μl by adding appropriate volumes.
Mix the reaction components.
Perform thermal cycling for 5 cycles: 30 seconds at 95 °C, 2 minutes at 68 °C, 1 minute at 55 °C, and 5 minutes at 60 °C.
Perform thermal cycling for another 5 cycles: 30 seconds at 95 °C, 2 minutes at 65 °C, 1 minute at 55 °C, and 5 minutes at 60 °C.
Hold the reaction at 10 °C.
UV treat tubes and nuclease-free water to remove potential DNA contaminations.
Add 3 μl Exo I (NEB) to the circularization reaction.
Add 0.6 μl Exo III (NEB) to the circularization reaction.
Incubate for 45 minutes at 37 °C.
Incubate for 20 minutes at 80 °C.
Hold the reaction at 10 °C after digestion.
Combine circular DNA from previous step with 2 μl of 25 mM dNTPs (Epicentre).
Add 0.8 μl of 10 mg/ml BSA (NEB) to the reaction mixture.
Mix in 0.4 μl of 10 x Phi29 buffer (NEB).
Pipette 2 μl of 100 μM N6T2 (IDT) into the mixture.
Add 2 μl of Phi29 high fidelity DNA polymerase (NEB) to the reaction.
Include 1 μl DMSO, UV-treated (Stratagene).
Pipette 2 μl H2O, UV-treated (Ambion), into the mixture.
The total reaction volume is 20 μl.
Heat the reaction mixture at 80°C for 2 min and cool on ice for 2 min before adding Phi29 DNA polymerase.
Mix the reactions by pipetting.
Incubate the reactions at 10°C for 10 min, then at 28°C for 16 h, followed by 65°C for 10 min, and hold at 10°C after RCA.
Prepare an XhoI digestion reaction containing 2 μl of RCA product, 2 μl of 10 x buffer (NEB), 0.2 μl of XhoI (NEB), 1 μl H2O, and 14.8 μl of water for a total volume of 20 μl.
Incubate the digestion reaction at 37°C for 1 h.
Take 10 μl of the digested sample to run on a 1.5% agarose gel.
Combine 4 tubes of RCA products together.
Add 120 μl nuclease-free water to bring a total volume of 200 μl.
Extract once with phenol/chloroform.
Extract once with chloroform.
Perform ethanol precipitation.
Qualify the RCA products by Nanodrop spectrophotometer.

Prepare the following reaction in a 1.7 ml tube: add 16 μg RCA product, 18 μl 10x buffer (NEB), 20 μl SAM diluted to 500 μM using 1x NEB buffer 4, 10 μl MmeI at 2U/μl (NEB), and nuclease-free water to reach a total volume of 200 μl.
Incubate the reaction at 37 °C for 30 min.
Concentrate the reaction to 12 μl with two DNA clean & concentrator-5 columns (ZYMO).
Load 6 μl of purified DNA to one lane in a 6% acrylamide gel.
Run the vertical gel at 200 V for 1.5 h.
Compare the intensity of bands with the DNA standard to estimate that the desired DNA fragment is ~7.2 pmol.
Purify the MmeI digested small fragment overnight.
Use a new Razor Blade to cut the desired band (~94 bp) which contains both TSS sequence and 3’ downstream tag.
Elute each gel slice with 400 μl gel elution buffer (0.1% SDS, 0.2 NaCl, 10 mM MgOAc2).
Rotate at least 6 h at room temperature or overnight at 4 °C.
Phenol/chloroform extract the sample.
Ethanol precipitate the extracted material.
Resuspend the sample in 20 μl nuclease-free water.
Ligate paired-end linkers to purified DNA overnight at 16 °C with T4 DNA ligase buffer, PE2_AN2 linker, and PE2_BN2 linker.
Mix the reaction for at least 20 times to ensure even distribution of PEG8000.
Phenol/chloroform extract the ligation product.
Concentrate the extracted product using ZYMO Clean & Concentrator-5 kit.
Elute the concentrated ligation product with 10 μl nuclease-free water.
Prepare a PCR reaction mixture by adding 2.5 μl of 10 μM PE2_AFN2_short.
Add 2.5 μl of 10 μM PE2_A_short to the PCR reaction mixture.
Include 2.5 μl of 10 μM PE2_BRN2_short in the PCR reaction mixture.
Mix in 2.5 μl of 10 μM PE2_B_short into the PCR reaction mixture.
Add 1 μl of 10 mM dNTP mix to the PCR reaction mixture.
Pipette 0.5 μl of Phusion HF DNA polymerase into the PCR reaction mixture.
Incorporate 18.5 μl of nuclease-free water into the PCR reaction mixture.
Incubate for 30 seconds at 98 °C.
Perform 2 cycles of 10 seconds at 98 °C, followed by 10 seconds at 66 °C and 30 seconds at 72 °C.
Conduct 10 cycles of 10 seconds at 98 °C, followed by 10 seconds at 69 °C and 30 seconds at 72 °C.
Extend the reaction for 10 minutes at 72 °C.
Hold the reaction at 10 °C after PCR completion.
Take 3 μl of PCR product to run on a 1.5% agarose gel.
Analyze the gel to observe a specific band of approximately 213 bp.
Perform size selection (~180 bp) if non-specific amplification is very strong.
Conduct size selection in an acrylamide gel overnight for libraries with good quality.
Use ZYMO DNA clean & concentrator-5 kit to purify the remaining 47 μl PCR product.
Elute with 6 μl nuclease-free water.
Load the purified sample onto an 8% acrylamide gel.
Run the gel at 1 w for 1 hr.
Stain the acrylamide gel with EtBr for 2 min.
Cut the ~213 bp band under UV transilluminator.
Elute the gel slice with 400 μl gel elution buffer (0.1% SDS, 0.3M NaOAc, pH5.2).
Rotate at room temperature for at least 6 h or overnight at 4 °C.
Purify the final library with ZYMO DNA clean & concentrator-5 kit.
Load multiple times for mixtures more than 700 μl.
Elute with 30 μl nuclease-free water.
Quantify the final library by Qubit fluorometer according to manufacturer’s protocol.
Use 5 μl out of 30 μl final library for QC by Sanger sequencing.
The final library passed QC was subjected to paired-end sequencing by Illumina Genome Analyzer IIx.
